sectionDescription: A solution to connect family heritage

features.title: Phygital Bridge
features.description: A set of elegant physical cards integrating an identification QR code on each card, allowing parents to easily activate recording and storytelling on the Zalo Mini App with a simple touch, completely eliminating barriers related to complex technology usage.

features.title: Memory Management System
features.description: Provides 'Editor-in-Chief' rights to the child to organize, label, and add emotions to each fragment of their parents' memories.

features.title: Legacy Timeline
features.description: Customizable timeline interface, connecting disparate storytelling fragments into a coherent narrative about the family.

features.title: Future Sharing Mode
features.description: Set access rights for future generations, transforming memories into a living 'digital will' for descendants wherever they are.

marketTitle: Why now is the time to act
marketText: The Vietnamese expatriate community is rapidly growing and aging. Each passing day is a page of family history at risk of being lost forever. Don't let yourself say 'If only'.
